document: Table 3. Added value of digital microphone
title: Table 3. Added value of digital microphone
text_helper: Table 3. Added value of digital microphone — section 1.6 Added value of digital microphones. Feature, Added value.

rows: Immunity to RF noise and electromagnetic interference (EMI)

– Easier application design – Direct interface to codecs with digital microphones interface – Stereo mode needs only one data line – Significant saving on PCB area with more microphones in system – Flexibility to add additional microphones into the application
– Easy MEMS positioning on application system – Standard digital conditioning – Allows audio enhancement integration for stereo capture, noise cancellation and beam forming
